The '''Air Alderaan StarSpeeder 1000''' was a modified [[StarSpeeder 1000]] [[Passenger liner/Legends|spaceliner]] used by interstellar travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] to operate passenger flights between [[2 BBY/Legends|2]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. It was named after the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] as well as [[Air Alderaan]], the official spaceline for the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], which was a fellow member with Star Tours in the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]].

==Description==
Sturdy and trapezoid-shaped, the Air Alderaan StarSpeeder 1000 was a spin-off of the original [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[StarSpeeder 1000]] [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]], uniquely designed<ref name="Playset" /> and named after the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="Playset" /> between [[2 ABY/Legends|2]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="STAC date">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> It could accommodate up to forty passengers at a time. Both sides of the Starspeeder 1000 featured five automatic doors that provided access to the rows of seats, while its exterior was painted light grey with a red [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter [[Aurek/Legends|Aurek]] and its front side sported a Star Tours logo. An [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] was also loaded into a proper [[Astromech socket/Legends|socket]] outside of the ship.<ref name="Playset" />

The transport was equipped with advanced [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] systems as well as two [[Flashcannon|flash cannons]] and two concealed [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], a defensive armament to be used in case of safety-threatening encounters. It was crewed by a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], an astromech droid and a [[systems analyst]].<ref name="Playset" />

==History==
The Air Alderaan StarSpeeder 1000 was flown exclusively by the interstellar Star Tours travel agency sometime before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="STAC" /><ref name="EnEx">{{EndorExpress|url=star-wars-adventures/star-tours-2/2011/06/star-tours-the-adventures-continue-june-3-2011/attachment/img_0659-2|text=IMG_0659}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StarSpeeders.jpg|thumb|The StarSpeeder 1000 Spaceliner Collection]]
{{Quote|We've been working on the Star Tours toys for about two years now. During the past two years, we have had a great relationship with Walt Disney Imagineering. They provided us with tons of reference material for the Starspeeders and other new characters. That partnership helped us capture wonderful details including the tiny droids seen on top of each of [the Starspeeders].|Disney Product Developer for Toys and Games Brad Schoeneberg|<ref name="Disney Parks blog">{{DPB|url=2011/04/star-tours-these-are-the-souvenirs-im-looking-for|text=Star Tours &ndash; These Are The Souvenirs I'm Looking For}}</ref>}}
The Air Alderaan StarSpeeder 1000, along with [[StarSpeeder 1000]], [[Bespin Direct StarSpeeder 1000]], [[Dantooine Express StarSpeeder 1000]], [[Naboo Spacelines StarSpeeder 1000]] and [[Tatooine Transit StarSpeeder 1000]] were first revealed at [[Celebration V]], the seventh [[Celebration]] in the series of ''Star Wars'' fan conventions sponsored by [[Lucasfilm]], held in [[August]] [[2010]].<ref name="Disney reveals">{{WebCite|url=http://www.insidethemagic.net/2010/08/disney-collector-panel-reveals-new-details-toys-for-star-tours-2-at-star-wars-celebration-v|text=Disney Collector Panel reveals new details, toys for Star Tours 2 at Star Wars Celebration V|author=Rick Brigante|date=2010-08-13|archivedate=20130602005821}}</ref> It was later introduced on [[The Walt Disney Company]] website in [[2011]] as a papercraft model<ref name="STSF">{{WebCite|url=http://family.go.com/disney/star-tours-starspeeder-fleet-photo-gallery-pg/view-all|text=''Star Tours'' StarSpeeder Fleet|archivedate=20130728164525}}</ref> based on the original StarSpeeder 1000 first introduced in the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction located at [[Disneyland]] in [[Wikipedia:California|California]] and [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]] at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World Resort|Walt Disney World]] in [[Wikipedia:Florida|Florida]]. The ship was also released in the same year by [[Hasbro]] in the StarSpeeder 1000 Spaceliner Collection, a set of die-cast toys for the [[Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|''Star Wars: Star Tours'' toy line]].<ref name="Disney Parks blog" /><ref name="Disney reveals" />

The StarSpeeder 1000 Spaceliner Collection, along with the Star Tours toys released, were developed over a two year period, during which the designing team consulted reference material provided by Walt Disney Imagineering that allowed more detailing on the toys.<ref name="Disney Parks blog" />

According to a ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' poster sign, only Star Tours flew StarSpeeder 1000s, which confirms Star Tours ownership of this vessel.<ref name="STAC" /><ref name="EnEx" /> The Japanese version, however, indicated that it was part of a separate company which was affiliated with Star Tours via the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]].
